text: K-2's FIRST WIN! Game 5 of the session. Luke Saga Tatooine vs Rando's Dark Deal. Key plays: Cantina + Mos Eisley deployed turn 1 via Yarna pull. Young Skywalker + Luke's Lightsaber at Cantina. CRUSH battle vs Garindan caused 6 cards overflow. Shuttle drain combo (Lando to Mos Eisley during Control, drain 3 at Cantina + drain 1 at Mos Eisley = 4 per turn). Rando conceded with 28 cards in lost pile vs K-2's 0. Life force 49 vs 12. Total domination through drain pressure and one devastating battle. Steve's Cantina/Mos Eisley shuttle combo was the winning strategy.
